summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Frasberg | Luchii Trading Bot clone. 31/31 pytest API tests pass. All UI flows exercised: admin login, operator registration, dashboard panels (ACTIVE ENGINE, PNL, candle chart, MINOFISH, ORDER BOOK, RECENT, ANALYTICS, EXECUTION LOG, #1 TRADER), REAL badge + live BTC/ETH header prices, START toast guard, KILL + RE-ARM, RESET, Settings modal (config/guardrails/brokers/alerts/wallet/exchange), EXCHANGE list has 15 exchanges in exact order with passphrase field only for okx/kucoin/bitget, fake kraken/okx keys produce 'Exchange verification failed' toast, WALLET tab shows REAL WALLET + self-custody + payment apps, ALERTS set with chat ID saves, BROKERS tab has PocketOption form (bogus ssid rejected), /chat shows all three Luchii models and returns 'temporarily unavailable' assistant reply (503 by design, no LLM key), /help /company /info/capabilities load, contact form submits, theme toggle flips the html.light class, title and 2026 footer verified, no forbidden brand words (Claude/Anthropic/Sonnet/Emergent) in rendered text.

minor.issue: With obviously-fake keys ccxt raises a base64 decode error from secret parsing BEFORE the HTTP auth call, so the toast reads 'Exchange verification failed: Error: Invalid base64-encoded string...' instead of 'AuthenticationError...'. The 400+error-wrapping behaviour is correct and the prefix matches spec; only the inner error class name differs.

action_items: Optional: when kraken/okx/kucoin secret is not base64, catch cryptography/base64 errors in exchange_service.build_client and re-raise as AuthenticationError-style message for consistency with spec wording.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 587 lines — close to the 700 line limit, consider splitting routers (auth / bot / exchange / wallet / brokers / chat) into separate files to keep it maintainable.
CORS is wide open (allow_origins=*, allow_credentials=False). Acceptable but tighten in prod.
db.py presumably reads MONGO_URL at import time — ensure load_dotenv runs first (server.py does this correctly).
/api/chat/message always returns 503 by design (user declined LLM key). Function signature still accepts ChatIn and reads `user` but neither is used; that is intentional for the stub.
exchange_service.build_client passes raw ccxt timeouts but no explicit sandbox flag — fine for live-only.
test_credentials: admin@gravia.io / Gravia@2026 (confirmed working, role=admin). Registered throwaway TEST_* users during run (not deleted; no admin cleanup endpoint).
seed_data_creation: Admin user is auto-seeded by auth.seed_admin on startup. A handful of TEST_<uuid>@example.com operators were created via /api/auth/register for test isolation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers health, auth, bot CRUD/state, exchange guards, wallet web3 link/unlink, alerts, brokers, chat/help offline (503), contact, leaderboard. Use the same TEST_ email prefix convention. Dashboard testids live on BotStatusCard (bot-start-button, bot-kill-button, rearm-button, bot-reset-button, bot-equity), Header (open-settings-button, theme-toggle-button, open-chat-button, open-help-button, logout-button), SettingsModal (settings-tab-select is a <select>, not tab buttons; options: config/guardrails/brokers/alerts/wallet/exchange). Chat uses chat-input + chat-send-button. Expect chat-message-assistant to say 'Luchii is temporarily unavailable…' (503 by design, no LLM key).
rca of the issue: No defects found. Only minor cosmetic mismatch: kraken fake-key error says 'Invalid base64-encoded string' rather than 'AuthenticationError'. Root cause: ccxt.kraken decodes the secret as base64 at request-signing time; invalid base64 raises binascii.Error before any HTTP call. Mitigation (optional): wrap base64/decrypt failures in exchange_service and re-raise as ccxt.AuthenticationError, or special-case the toast prefix. User impact is nil — the user still gets a 400 with 'Exchange verification failed: …' and nothing is persisted.
